text:
zoe: Quick sync — we need a lean GA checklist for the upcoming launch. Two non-negotiables: customer data residency controls + tiered SLOs by customer segment. Who owns what?

liam: I'll own SLO definition/validation. Proposed tiers: Gold p99 <200ms, 99.95% uptime; Silver p99 <400ms, 99.9% uptime; Bronze best-effort + documented fallbacks.

anjali: Ill take docs & onboarding flows. Need exact playbook language for throttles/failovers and a clear FAQ for data residency (hosted/dedicated/private).

devin: Infra gating: per-tenant region pinning in control plane + audit logs exported to customer KMS. Both need QA in staging. ETA 3 business days for tests.

sam: Pricing: propose +20% premium for Gold SLA, +8% for Silver, Bronze no premium. Need overage/backstop terms for retries/excess tokens.

zoe: Assign monitoring/alerts: @liam add error-budget thresholds and paged vs non-paged alerts.

liam: Suggested alerts: error_budget_burn_rate >5%/1h -> slack alert (non-paged); >20%/1h -> page oncall. Latency regression: p95 >2x baseline -> non-paged, escalate if >30m sustained.

anjali: Docs checklist for GA: API contract, SLA table, enable-data-residency guide, migration guide (hosted->dedicated), downgrade guidance, billing examples. Will draft and link examples.

devin: Ops blockers: need a smoke test validating per-tenant KV cache pinning and cross-region tail latency. I'll add to smoke pipeline.

sam: Commercial: legal wants SLA penalties spelled out (credits-only). Also need a sales one-pager summarizing tiers, limits, cutover playbook.

zoe: Action items: liam -> finalize SLO numbers + error budget policy (due EOD tomorrow); anjali -> first docs draft + customer FAQ (48h); devin -> gating tests in staging + KMS export proof (48h); sam -> publish pricing delta + sales one-pager (72h). Flag blockers here.

liam: Add fallback policies: automatic model-fallback to smaller quantized variant when burst latency exceeds threshold; degrade streaming chunk size to improve p99. I'll include in SLO docs.

ops-bot: deploy-checker: staging smoke: per-tenant-region-pincheck queued.

anjali: Suggest standardized residency copy: "Region-bound (hosted)", "Dedicated-region", "Private-airgapped" with guarantees for logs, keys, backups. Will sketch copy.

devin: Note: For Private/airgapped we cant promise real-time SLA parity until customer network validated — mark "SLA contingent on network test" in runbook.

zoe: Governance: GA gating requires signoff from Product, Infra, Security, and Sales Ops. Anyone unable to sign in 72h should flag.

sam: I'll coordinate Sales Ops signoff after the one-pager lands.

liam: Sample SLA table to include in docs (to be refined):
```
Tier | p99 lat | Uptime | Credits
Gold | <200ms | 99.95% | 10% monthly credit for breach
Silver | <400ms | 99.9% | 5% monthly credit
Bronze | best-effort | N/A | none
```

anjali: I'll add invoice examples showing credit calculations.

zoe: Treat these as minimal GA acceptance criteria unless objections. I'll run signoff tracker when deliverables land. :thumbsup: 

devin: Infra has no objections.

liam: Will post SLO PR tomorrow morning.

sam: Ack, pricing sheet by EOD Fri.

anjali: Starting doc PR now and will post link.

zoe: Thanks — keep thread updated with blockers.
